summary: The recorded base reproduces the original silent count collision, returning [1, 16, 31, 46, 61] when the trained taps are [5, 19, 33, 47, 61]. At the exact candidate commit, the formula helper is removed, both production callers use the required-ID API, missing target_layer_ids raises a clear ValueError, and explicit IDs resolve verbatim. Focused regression, full nearby unit coverage, and independent boundary cases pass.

tests.what_was_measured: On base commit 358c163, a five-layer draft without target_layer_ids silently resolved five guessed taps [1, 16, 31, 46, 61], differing from trained taps [5, 19, 33, 47, 61].
Candidate regression and boundary coverage: 6 passed, 10 deselected.
Full nearby DFlash logits unit file: 16 passed.
Auxiliary hidden-state configuration call-site suite: 5 passed.
Missing IDs at collision and minimal depths reject; explicit trained and legacy top-level IDs remain verbatim; nested empty IDs reject.

gpu_execution.evidence: One assigned AMD Instinct MI355X (gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-) was visible through torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2, but the defect is deterministic configuration resolution and the candidate regression is CPU-only; no GPU kernel or model execution was needed or claimed.

remaining_limitations: No published DFlash checkpoint weights were available, so no full serving/model acceptance-rate run was performed.
The review does not independently verify the issue snapshot's survey of 20 external z-lab checkpoints; it verifies the concrete missing-key safety contract in the prepared implementation.
No native rebuild was applicable because the candidate changes only Python, tests, and report artifacts; imports were confirmed from /job/repo/python rather than an installed SGLang wheel.
